newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dowa Mining sees non-ferrous output flat.
newsitem.headline: Dowa Mining sees non-ferrous output flat.

text.p: Dowa Mining Co said on Wednesday it planned to hold its output of refined copper, zinc and lead in the half-year through March 1997 nearly unchanged from the same period a year ago.
It said it planned copper output at 11,257 tonnes per month, marginally below 11,264 tonnes in the year-ago period but above 11,186 tonnes of estimated output in April-September 1996.
Zinc output was planned at 7,654 tonnes per month, unchanged from the year-ago period and above 7,386 tonnes in April-September.
The company is planning to produce 2,000 tonnes of lead per month, barely above 1,989 tonnes in the year-ago period and unchanged from April-September.
Gold and silver output is planned at 1.11 tonnes and 53 tonnes per month, respectively, compared with 0.995 tonnes and 50 tonnes in the year-ago period.
